messages:
nina_ae: Hi all 2 new AE here (nina). Trying to sign into Salesforce / Gong / HubSpot and hitting SSO errors or 'no access'. Anyone quick to help with provisioning?

ops-amy: welcome @nina_ae! Did you follow the onboarding checklist link from HR? That kicks off the app requests.

nina_ae: I followed it but Salesforce SSO redirects then shows "You don’t have access to this org". Gong gives an SSO error and HubSpot shows no workspace.

ops-amy: okay i'll open a ticket. @it-bot can you create a provisioning ticket for nina_ae: Salesforce (AE role), Gong (seat + call recordings), HubSpot (workspace invite) and add to #sales-playbooks?

it-bot: Ticket created: IT-2684  "Provision: nina_ae  Salesforce, Gong, HubSpot, sales drive". Assigned to rachel-ops-admin. ETA: 3 hours. Link: https://tickets.redwood.internal/IT-2684

sam_sdr: hey @nina_ae while ops sorts it you can use Gong mobile to listen to recs and Dialpad mobile for calls. also here's a quick voicemail script I use: `Hi, this is [Your Name] at Redwood Inference. Sorry I missed you 0 please leave a number and I'll follow up within one business day.`

nina_ae: perfect, thanks. also where do I find the AE playbook and objection cheatsheet?

ops-amy: AE playbook one-pager: https://redwood.example.com/sales/ae-one-pager (internal). Full playbook + objection sheet in the drive: /sales/playbooks. I'll add you once ticket completes.

it-bot: IT-2684 update: Salesforce group mapping missing for AE role; applying mapping. Gong SSO cert issue escalated to SSO team. HubSpot workspace invite queued.

ops-amy: quick note  if you need immediate access to sequences, ping me and I can share a read-only copy of our outbound sequence templates.

sales-ops-bot: Pro tip: enable HubSpot email sync (settings -> integrations -> email) to auto-cc redwood-sales@redwood.com so call emails log automatically.

it-bot: IT-2684 status: Completed. Salesforce AE role applied, Gong invite sent (seat active), HubSpot workspace invite accepted. Closed by rachel-ops-admin at 2026-03-23T19:10:12Z.

nina_ae: confirmed I can log into Salesforce and Gong now. HubSpot invite worked too. Thanks everyone!

ops-amy: great  added you to #sales-playbooks and the playbooks drive. Scheduling a 30-min walkthrough tomorrow 11:00 PT to go over sequences and playbooks.

onboarding-bot: Welcome DM sent to nina_ae with quickstart links, checklist, and the 1:1 scheduling link: https://cal.com/redwood/sales-30
